page_title: MON 0-0 LEC | Monza v Lecce 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
90+2' A lofted pass finds Tete Morente (Lecce) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Kacper Urbanski makes his way off the pitch and Kevin Martins (Monza) comes on as his replacement.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Konan Ndri (Lecce) for Santiago Pierotti.
89' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).

88' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
86' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Monza.
85' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) swings in a cross from the corner, but Stefano Turati reads it well and gathers the ball.

85' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
82' The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
81' Stefano Turati leaps to intercept the corner kick from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).

81' What a chance! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance. Lecce win a corner.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Keita Balde (Monza) is replacing Silvere Ganvoula.
78' Substitution. Danilo D'Ambrosio makes way for Arvid Brorsson (Monza).
76' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danilo Veiga (Lecce) replacing Frederic Guilbert.
74' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is punished with the yellow card.
72' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Tete Morente (Lecce) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Monza, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
71' The ball is out of play. Lecce will take a throw-in.
70' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Wladimiro Falcone. Corner kick. Monza will have an opportunity.
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Balthazar Pierret walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ylber Ramadani (Lecce).
69' The ball has crossed the sideline. Monza are taking a throw-in.
65' Alessandro Nesta has decided to make a change. Kevin Zeroli (Monza) replaces Patrick Ciurria.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) comes onto the pitch so that Dany Mota can be given a rest.

62' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the left post is, however, superbly saved by Wladimiro Falcone!
61' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

61' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
59' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Armando Izzo (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play. Lecce win a free kick.
58' It's a throw-in for Lecce.
56' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Monza.
55' Pedro Pereira (Monza) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
52' Andrea Carboni (Monza) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
49' Monza have a free kick. Tete Morente (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
48' It's a throw-in for Lecce.
47' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' The ball is behind the touchline and Monza will take a throw-in.

46' Kacper Urbanski (Monza) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giuseppe Collu no option but to blow his whistle. Lecce will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Giuseppe Collu who sees an offensive foul. Monza are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
44' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
42' Andrea Carboni (Monza) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce are awarded the free kick.

41' What a save from Stefano Turati! Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
40' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) probably handled the ball. Monza have a free kick.
39' Giuseppe Collu couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) and blew his whistle. Monza earn a free kick.
39' Pedro Pereira (Monza) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
38' The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
37' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
36' The ball is out of play. Monza will take a throw-in.
35' Pedro Pereira (Monza) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

35' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
33' The game is interrupted. Armando Izzo (Monza) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
33' Handball by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). Monza will take a free kick.
32' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lecce.

31' Stefano Turati is a nightmare for the offensive players! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.
31' The resulting corner from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
30' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lecce.
29' The players claim that Alessandro Bianco (Monza) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. A free kick is awarded to Lecce.
28' The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.
26' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Giuseppe Collu stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Monza.

26' Antonino Gallo pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
24' It's a throw-in for Lecce.

23' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Tete Morente (Lecce). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

23' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
22' Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul after Dany Mota (Monza) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.
21' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Tete Morente (Lecce) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Monza have been awarded a free kick.
19' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stefano Turati, who smothers the ball.
18' The ball has crossed the sideline. Lecce are taking a throw-in.
17' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

16' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lecce are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' 67:33 – the ratio of ball possession.
13' The ball is out of play. Monza will have a throw-in.

12' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) blows a huge opportunity after receiving a cross from the free kick. He shoots from just outside of the box, but the ball goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
11' Armando Izzo (Monza) commits a rough challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for an infringement. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
9' The game is interrupted as Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is flagged offside.
8' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.
7' The ball is behind the touchline and Lecce will take a throw-in.
7' Monza hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
5' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
2' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lecce in a dangerous position.
1' The first half has just begun.
Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Giuseppe Collu was nominated as the referee for this game.
